## Takedown

- Private request reference (no link to a public issue; no personal data):
- Object IDs to remove or mask:
- Correction record file (`type: takedown`): `corrections/<YYYY>/cr-YYYYMMDD-nn.yaml`
- Does the personal data appear in git history? (yes or no; a yes goes to the maintainer, see Q-10)

## PR review fields

review_sensitive: true
review_reason:

## Checklist

- [ ] A senior editor decided the request (CONTRIBUTING, section 7).
- [ ] The public correction record does not write the removed personal data.
- [ ] Two approvals, one from a senior editor.
- [ ] `islandlog validate .` passes on my machine.

Labels to add after you open the PR: `takedown`, `privacy-review`.
